evidence: Tenancy verdict: PASS with 1 cross-tenant defect. Traced all 203 route.ts files across the 4 auth systems. Admin routes (admin-*, ecri, ideas, drip-sequences, churn-predictions, campaign-*, etc.) call requireAdminKey/isAdminRequest.
